integrity: The recurrence and restart signs are proved algebraically and replayed with exact rational arithmetic. Literature comparisons are limited to the cited primary sources, targeted searches, and the indexed published-finding database; an unindexed note could contain the same resonance.
limitations: Exact for the constant-momentum scalar quadratic model used in the source analysis. It does not assert non-triggering for the full varying-momentum accelerated sequence, and a non-strict objective comparison would behave differently at equality transitions.
title: A scalar resonance where function-based accelerated-gradient restart never fires
